name: quantizer_10bit
description: quantizer to 10 bits on a real signal

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: Same rounding (to even at exact ties) and the same scaling by powers of two: identical.

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Input and output are on the Q15 grid and the quantiser step is a multiple of it: the rounding is the same integer rounding, to even: identical.
